title: Duopra: From Full-Duplex Conversation to Full-Duplex Agency
abstract: arXiv:2611.25773v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Full-duplex interaction models exhibit strong conversational agency, enabling natural, low-latency turn-taking, backchannels, and interruptions. However, completing tasks further requires task agency: timely tool invocation and argument revision following user corrections. Frontend-backend agents separate initiation from execution: the frontend decides whether and what to request, while the backend determines how. Execution can be offloaded, but unsent requests cannot be executed, and incomplete ones can misdirect the backend. On Full-Duplex-Bench v3 (FDB v3), most failures of Realtime-Venus-Audio + Harness in our streaming pipeline occur before a domain tool executes. We introduce Duopra, a full-duplex interaction model that learns task execution alongside conversational control. translated_title: Duopra：从全双工对话到全双工智能体
translated_abstract: 全双工交互模型展现出强大的对话主动性，能够实现自然、低延迟的轮次交替、附和回应（backchannel）与打断。然而，完成任务还需要任务主动性：及时的工具调用以及在用户纠正后对参数的修订。前后端分离的智能体将请求发起与执行分开：前端决定是否请求以及请求什么，后端则决定如何执行。执行过程可以被卸载，但未被发送的请求无法执行，而不完整的请求则可能误导后端。在 Full-Duplex-Bench v3（FDB v3）上，我们流式管道中 Realtime-Venus-Audio + Harness 的大多数失败发生在领域工具执行之前。我们提出了 Duopra，一个在学习对话控制的同时学习任务执行的全双工交互模型。Duopra 将后端视为一个工具，接受自包含的自然语言请求。直接调用与后端委托共享同一个动作接口与请求……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 提出全双工交互模型 Duopra，通过将后端视为接受自包含自然语言请求的工具，使模型在学习对话控制的同时掌握任务执行能力，从而将全双工交互从对话层面扩展到智能体层面。
en_tdlr: We introduce Duopra, a full-duplex interaction model that learns task execution alongside conversational control by treating the backend as a tool accepting self-contained natural-language requests, extending full-duplex interaction from conversation to full-duplex agency.
